material.description: blocked_by: gap-tick-cost-reduction-under-overrun. The 1 us tight run measures sim.tick() at about 2 us per tick on CI (run 38898909117, 2059 tick-overrun lines). Named non-sim work in room.rs step (drain, Instant reads, histogram, println) is not a cost the sim pays and cannot bring cost_us under 1 us. So the overrun counter keeps incrementing every tick under the tight run; the stop-climbing acceptance is unreachable without redefining overrun, which would be gaming the counter. Receipt: .gm/receipts/gap-tick-cost-reduction-under-overrun/01-orient.md. Needs an owner decision: (a) a bound stated on shed ticks only with a budget above the measured sim floor, or (b) change the acceptance to the loose-budget half, which is achievable.
material.subject: Blocker: tick-overrun count cannot stop climbing under a 1 us budget
material.witness: codesearch regex 'tick-overrun|tick-shed|overrun' over rust, scripts, .github: the 2 hits are unrelated (a buffer section overrun in data/persist.rs, an mpq sparse run in mpq/sparse.rs). No tick-overrun counter exists: the server crate that held room.rs was removed (f4f7cf5a). Stale: nothing is left to rescope, so no owner decision is needed.
